title: Cluj Napoca celebrate Liga Nationala title
description: Voluntari - Cluj Napoca 74-85 Cluj Napoca clinched Liga Nationala title. They beat Voluntari in Game 4 of the Finals to capture the trophy. The guests trailed by 3 points after three quarters before their 27-13 charge, which allowed them to win the game. 27 personal fouls committed by Voluntari helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. Worth to mention a great performance of the former international swingman Patrick Richard (196-1990, college: McNeese St., agency: Inception Sports) who helped to win the game recording 19 points and American center Dustin Hogue (198-1992, college: Iowa St.) who added 15 points and 5 rebounds during the contest. Four Cluj Napoca players scored in double figures.
